applicabilityBasis.summary: HedgeCore sUSD is a wallet-bound receipt for a USDC-funded Venus lending/hedging position, with transfer restrictions while locked. Protocol-controlled reward minting distributes 93% of lending yield to the position, and operator-controlled early redemption returns underlying USDC; no fixed fiat monetary-value redemption undertaking is established.

references.label: HedgeCore protocol architecture: Venus vault and operator control

genius.notes: sUSD is a non-payment protocol position, not ordinary transferable USDC and not a Circle-issued token. Yield and USDC exit depend on protocol/operator mechanics. Exact legal issuer entity and domicile were not established from the protocol disclosures, so neither is invented. No GENIUS payment-stablecoin authorization is asserted.
